use_cases: Triggers actions or events when clicked by users
Submits forms or confirms user decisions in workflows
Navigates users between pages or sections within an application
Toggles states like opening/closing panels or modals
Provides accessible interactive controls with keyboard navigation support
ai_summary: A flexible button component with multiple visual variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and size options (default, small, large, icon). Built with class-variance-authority for scalable variant management and Radix UI's Slot for composition flexibility. Features standard accessibility attributes including focus-visible rings and disabled states. Standard flat Tailwind styling suitable as a foundational UI element in any application.
